count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      let data = fs.read(name) else continue
      n += 1
  n

test_count_readable_empty() uses fs =
  assert count_readable([]) == 0
